bioconda.name: kpop
bioconda.summary: An assembly-free and scalable method for the comparative analysis of microbial genomes, based on full k-mer spectra and dataset-specific transformations.
bioconda.description: KPop is an assembly-free and scalable method for the comparative analysis of microbial genomes, based on full k-mer spectra and dataset-specific transformations. It is built using OCaml <https://ocaml.org> and R <https://www.r-project.org/>.
